test_psm_num_conv_locations: test the psm.num_conv_locations function to calculate the number of convolutional locations given spatial shape, kernel shape, strides, and padding
test_psm_patches_moments: test the psm.patches_moments function to compute patches second moment matrices and vectors for 2D convolution with configurable data format and per-channel mode
test_psm_patches_moments_explicit: test the psm.patches_moments_explicit function as an explicit loop-based reference implementation for patches second moment computation
test_psm_patches_moments_vs_explicit: test that psm.patches_moments produces results matching psm.patches_moments_explicit across various kernel shapes, strides, padding modes, and data formats
test_psm_custom_padding: test psm.patches_moments with custom asymmetric padding tuples for both per_channel True and False configurations
